# Bay Area Office Systems

> Family-run copier dealer in the San Francisco Bay Area since 1995. We lease, rent, sell and service professionally refurbished Ricoh color multifunction copiers (print, copy, scan) for businesses, schools, law firms, churches and nonprofits.

- Service area: San Francisco, the Peninsula, Oakland and the East Bay, Marin, and parts of the South Bay
- Address: 124 Santa Cruz Ave, Daly City, CA 94014
- Contact: info@bayareaofficesystems.com (email preferred), (650) 992-2000, Monday to Friday 9 to 5
- Options: leases, month-to-month and short-term rentals, refurbished sales, service plans (per-page or flat monthly) or pay per visit
- Service is done by our own local technician, usually the next business day
- Pricing is quoted by email based on monthly print volume
